channel.title: Dusty Farts
channel.description: Two old friends, one booth, and enough coffee to fuel a small-town power grid. Dusty Farts is an immersive comedy podcast that blends Americana warmth with absurd banter, diner-grade philosophy, and a touch of the surreal.
channel.itunes:author: Brian Clark
